supersedes: sleep_animations.json (v1 slump/standby) -- the night behaviour is now a scripted bedtime ROUTINE, not a single sleep pose.
note: At night each character runs a scripted bedtime ROUTINE: an ordered chain of one-shot transitions + dwell-idles that takes it from its awake hub, OFFSCREEN to change, and into its sleep state, where it dwells until wake_hour, then plays the chain in REVERSE for a morning wake-up. The chain is deterministic (a ritual repeats); variety lives in the random dwell-idles at each beat. Each character's routine is derived from its TYPE + chosen METAPHOR: phineas stays a PORTRAIT (he never leaves the painting's logic -- he changes offscreen and sleeps slumped in his own chair, candle out); maxx is a ROOM (the panel is his apartment -- he powers down into a charging pod revealed by a zoom-out). This file is the single source of truth the generator (_shots/_routine_*.py) and the graph wiring (runtime/video_graph.py bedtime block) consume.
_video_gen_best_practices: STILL vs MOTION are different prompts. A node STILL is a full descriptive /imagine (re-states subject + setting; identity held by --oref the awake hub). Every CLIP is image-to-video so its motion_prompt is MOTION ONLY -- never re-describe the subject/scene or the model regenerates one.

LOCK THE CAMERA by default: every motion_prompt ends on the global `camera` directive. The ONLY exception is a transition flagged camera_override:true (maxx's zoom-out to the pod), which carries its own dolly cue. phineas has NO camera moves (he stays a portrait).
EXPLICIT TEMPORAL ARC, in order (first ... then ... settles). A transition is a one-way arc A->B; an idle is a closed arc whose end state == its start state so --end loop is seamless.
PACE LOW for sleep/standby (lead with slowly/softly/faintly, tiny amplitude); give the one 'turn in sleep' beat more amplitude; keep awake beats (the toast, the yawn) livelier.
REVERSE = FREE. The morning wake-up chain is the bedtime chain reversed frame-for-frame (no extra generation); pixel-exact closure.
OFFSCREEN COSTUME CHANGE: never animate changing. The character exits dressed; the frame sits EMPTY (the 'wait'); it returns already in nightclothes. Moderation-safe and classier.

MJ-SAFE NEGATIVES ONLY: never put body/clothing/sleepwear words (clothing, nightgown, undress, bare, naked) in a --no list -- the bare token trips MJ's NSFW filter and temp-blocks the account. Nightclothes go in the POSITIVE prompt (a long linen nightshirt, a tasseled nightcap -- fully clothed, period, modest).

MJ-SAFE MOTION: avoid 'yawn' + 'stretch' in a motion_prompt -- MJ's moderator flags 'yawning/stretching' as possibly-sexual (rejected seraphina+maxx prep beats 2026-05-29). Use other wind-down gestures (sleepy blink, slump, hand to collar). And keep transition motion_prompts MOTION-ONLY (no garment words) -- the end-frame still holds the costume, and re-stating 'nightgown'/'woman' in a motion prompt is more flag-prone.
camera: static locked-off camera, fixed frame, no camera movement, no zoom, no pan, no parallax

night_window.note: Wall-clock [start,end) when the bedtime routine is active. The sequencer re-checks the hour each beat so night can fall / break mid-show. Per-character circadian.bedtime_hour/wake_hour can stagger within this; default keeps both asleep across the deep-night overlap.
